workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Full3D Face Rotate

authority_chain.axis: AXIS::SELECTED_FACE_CENTER::LOCAL_POS_Y transformed with yaw+pitch so direction has XYZ components
authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape with sew/fix normalization and shell-to-solid rebuild when required

bounded_scope: source solid receives yaw then pitch, producing selected-face normal with non-zero X/Y/Z components
selected-face local +Y tangent rotation axis also has non-zero X/Y/Z components
R001 80x50x10 mm yaw +30 degrees, pitch +20 degrees, selected local +X face rotate +4 degrees
R002 100x60x12 mm yaw -25 degrees, pitch -15 degrees, selected local +X face rotate -4 degrees
semantic selector and semantic local-axis IDs persist while their world-space directions change across revisions
actual selected-face normal validates signed +4/-4 degree local-axis rotation within numerical tolerance
target plus four adjacent faces are rebuilt through BRepTools_ReShape while opposite face is not replaced
both revisions remain valid one-solid six-face B-Rep results
opposite face center and area remain unchanged and rotated target remains reselectable from expected normal
zero angle, angle greater than 12 degrees, axis with selected-face normal component, and selector miss all fail before accepted mutation
FCStd plus R001/R002 STEP artifacts persist yaw/pitch/angle/axis/selector authority metadata
Blender creates two tessellated display-only derivatives and preserves source hash/full-3D normal/full-3D axis/yaw/pitch/angle/authority across .blend save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate if yaw+pitch full-3D selector/axis derivation is replaced by fixed world-axis logic, semantic IDs become raw topology indices, signed-angle/failure gates are removed, geometry becomes mesh-authoritative, or authority does not survive Blender readback.
authority_note: This receipt proves bounded full-3D-oriented planar face rotation about one transformed semantic local tangent axis. It does not prove arbitrary user-defined axis, nonplanar rotation, persistent topological naming or P0-B PASS.
